items.title: Items in the feeds
items.description: All active items, or only those with an image (shopping catalogs refuse items without one).

includeOutOfStock.title: Include items out of stock
includeOutOfStock.description: Listed as out of stock; off leaves them out of the feeds.

itemTitle.title: Item titles
itemTitle.description: {name} is the product, {brand} its brand, {variant} the variant's options on products with several variants, {options} the variant's options always. Empty brackets and separators left over are dropped.

itemDescription.title: Item descriptions
itemDescription.description: The product's description (else its summary), or its SEO description first.

skuAs.title: Send the SKU as
skuAs.description: Shopping catalogs match items by GTIN (barcode) or MPN (manufacturer part number). Choose what your SKUs are.

identifierExists.title: Items without GTIN or MPN
identifierExists.description: Auto: nothing is sent and the catalog decides. No: identifier_exists no is sent on items with neither (custom or handmade goods).

gradedCondition.title: Condition of graded items
gradedCondition.description: The condition sent for graded items whose grade names no condition. Items without a grade are new.

googleCategory.title: Google product category
googleCategory.description: The Google product category of your items (an id or a path), sent with every item.

gradeLabel.title: Grade as custom label 0
gradeLabel.description: Send each item's grade label as custom_label_0.
